newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising, blue chips in demand.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising, blue chips in demand.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to continue their rally when the market reopens after the Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
"The investors will target blue chips instead of low priced shares," said broker Sabbir Ahmed.
Brokers said Singer Bangladesh, Chittagong Cement and Beximco Pharma might gain.
The DSE benchmark index closed 151.73 points or 3.43 percent up at 3,567.27 on Thursday.
